They called him The Drowner. He would abduct hot young women, bring them to his hideout, drown them, violate them as they lay dying, then resuscitating them before violating and drowning them for good. Here are his first 6 victims, showing each victim in order of
1. Alive and before abduction,
2. Drowned and being resuscitated.
3. After their bodies are found and delivered to the morgue (some are showing signs of decomposition)
